behavior: Forages actively in shallow water with a high-stepping walk, swift bill-stabs, and occasional runs after fish or aquatic invertebrates; often solitary or in loose groups.
field_marks: Very long, bright yellow to orange-yellow legs
Long, dark, slightly upturned bill with a sturdy base
Tall, lanky proportions with a long neck and small head
Dark gray-brown upperparts and folded wings with crisp pale spotting or checkering
Finely streaked head and neck with a distinct pale eye-ring
White belly, variably marked flanks, and a short, dark-barred white tail
habitat: Breeds in boreal bogs, wet meadows, sedgelands, and wet forest clearings; otherwise occupies shallow fresh, brackish, and coastal wetlands such as marshes, mudflats, pond edges, estuaries, and flooded fields.
